en.headline: Housing Bureau to replace checking unit with project-based control body
en.dek: About 300 staff will move to the new Public Housing Building Control Unit, which will assign dedicated teams and liaison officers for each major maintenance project.
body: Deputy Financial Secretary and acting Secretary for Housing Michael Wong said on Friday that the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit will be replaced within about a month by a new Public Housing Building Control Unit.

Wong said the change follows the independent committee’s report on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, which identified the unit as bearing the greatest responsibility among government bodies for failed supervision of the renovation works.

About 300 staff from the existing unit will transfer to the new body, which will adopt a project-based workflow. Each major maintenance job will have a dedicated team and a project liaison officer as a one-stop contact for owners’ corporations, consolidating inspection, structural checks, minor works and site monitoring that had previously been split across different desks.

A directorate-grade officer will be seconded from the Buildings Department to guide day-to-day work and keep enforcement standards aligned. Wong said communication with the Buildings Department, previously set at once every 12 months, has been changed to once a quarter, and training will aim to make personnel more vigilant about the relevant guidelines.
Wong said the project-based approach and stronger inter-departmental coordination were expected to improve the quality of future services for public housing maintenance.

zh.headline: 房屋局以項目制管制組替代獨立審查組
zh.dek: 約三百名職員將轉任新公營房屋樓宇管制組，每項大型維修工程會配對專責團隊及聯絡人員。
body: 財政司副司長兼暫任房屋局局長黃偉綸星期五表示，房屋局獨立審查組將在約一個月內被新的公營房屋樓宇管制組取代。
黃偉綸指，這更改是因應大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告，報告指出獨立審查組在監管維修工程上失責，應負上最大責任。
約三百名獨立審查組職員將轉任新組。新組採項目制流程，每項大型維修工程會有專責團隊及項目聯絡人員作為業主立案法團的一站式聯絡，整合先前分散在不同部門的巡查、結構檢查、小型工程及工地監察。
屋宇署將派一名首長級職員借調新組，指導日常工作並保持執法標準一致。黃偉綸表示，與屋宇署的溝通原本每十二個月一次，近期已改為每季一次，並會通過培訓加強人員對指引的警覺性。
黃偉綸指，項目制方法及加強跨部門協調，預期能提升未來公營房屋維修服務的質素。
